subject: STABLE: metal probe batch-features-v9 (host replica 8/8 PASS, gates green); HEAVY RELEASE
body: Root cause of the missing final records: the kernel LOG selector caps each user client at 16384 B (Nord2GPU.cpp:663); the v8 probe's own client logged 16.3 KB (c6gc/c6jb USB logs stop at 16279/16281 B, just before 'batch complete'). v9: per-pass status/memory and pixel-sample lines go to stdout only (est. kernel log ~8 KB of 16 KB; was 16.6 KB), a 2 KB reserve is kept for 'feature=', 'summary', 'batch complete' and final status/memory, and a summary line (features/failed/elapsed_ms/log_used/log_dropped) follows compute, geometry, formats and features, so a short capture still shows progress. New exact-pixel tests, run after the v8 passes (which use up the bridge's 64 traced synchronous draws, so these go down the async path), each tagged 'NORD2_METAL feature=<tag> checked mismatches result': tilefetch-batch (ordinary draws plus 3 framebuffer-fetch inverts in one LOAD pass, CPU oracle), preframe-partial (128x128 unique-seed LOAD, two small boxes, every untouched pixel bit-exact), batch-cap (100 per-colour 10x10 cells in one pass), indexed-attr (uint16 list quad), indexed-strip-restart (two strip quads joined by 0xFFFF, gap must stay clear), async-many (24 LOAD commands on one target plus 8 targets, committed back to back, one wait, then all read back), cmdpool-reuse (40 sequential commands of 1 and 3 draws, each read back). async-fault is reported as SKIP (context-unsafe). The probe sets its toggles itself (TEGU_AB_SCHEDULE pointed at a missing file so the UI A/B schedule is not used; PF=1 TF=1 JB=1 BM=128 NI=1 AS=1, a runner may override) and prints them on the start line. The bridge now logs the first 16 batches (traced runs only; these 16 complete synchronously): 'NORD2_METAL batch draws preload preframe heap-used heap'. New AIR tests/shaders/metal_probe_fetch.ll (framebuffer-fetch invert). varying.bc rebuilt with LLVM 23 (build_metal_probe.sh NORD2_AIR_LLVM_BIN=/usr/bin): the host replica parses and compiles every function from it (varying, fetch to LD_TILE, compute, quad) - device AIR parser is the same Rust source. Host replica (gpu/build/c6f-lowering-20261026/probe/probe_host.py: frame_bench prelude, real Rust/Mali, fake kernel, same draws): bitcode-functions, tilefetch-batch (1 job, chain 5, LD_TILE), preframe-partial (pre_frame_0 INTERSECT, 1 job), batch-cap (1 job, chain 100), indexed-attr, indexed-strip-restart, async-many (32 submits, WAIT_SEQ), cmdpool-reuse (40 pool hits) all PASS; pixels are device-only. Analyzer: batch-features-v9 qualifies only with every feature present once, PASS, checked>0 and 'features=7 features-failed=0'; reports per feature, the summaries, batch draws and max heap-used; also works on a capture cut short. Reconcile accepts v9 and skips stdout-only lines when matching the prefix. Gates: run_host_tests all PASS except the final probe step (needs NORD2_AIR_LLVM_BIN); I ran that step myself with NORD2_AIR_LLVM_BIN=/usr/bin and it PASSes. Integration 1005, only the known CA stride check fails. Render harness PASS; CA test 41/41 with PF 0 and 1; analyzer 7 tests and reconcile 6 tests OK. Hashes: . Packaging (package_metal_addon.py) is unchanged: it ships build/native/nord2-metal-probe and varying.bc. Not run on hardware.
